groupNotes.UI: Compose adoption at module level, interoperability with Views, and use of design-system typography. Pattern series count matching lines, including comments and tests.
groupNotes.Architecture: ViewModel and MVP inheritance patterns over time. These counts describe source code, not a screen migration percentage.
groupNotes.Tests: Unit and E2E test annotations, screenshot golden images, and their distribution across modules. Counts do not measure test coverage.
groupNotes.Tech debt: Detekt baseline entries and source-level markers to follow over time. These counts provide context, not a quality score.
groupNotes.Codebase: The size and structure of the codebase, and feature-toggle registry entries.
